thread:
Noah: quick all-hands Q&A on sales pipeline, GTM priorities, and partner motions. dropping a few numbers then open for questions.
Noah: current pipe coverage vs Q target: 3.4x overall, but skewed. Strategic Dedicated bucket only 1.1x.
Priya: can you break down by stage for Dedicated? committed vs forecast vs open?
Noah: committed: $2.1M, forecast (best case): $7.8M, open: $15.2M. Biggest time risk is PO/Legal on 3 accounts.
Ava: Legal/Procurement delays again. any patterns? certs/clauses?
Marco: most ask for SOC2 + custom DPA, and for one banking deal they also requested HSM integration details.
Lena: have we prepped a DPA template for Dedicated? that could shave weeks.
Carlos: Product already has a Dedicated compliance package doc. I'll post link after this thread.
Noah: action: @Carlos please share the Dedicated "procurement starter pack". Also mapping owners for the 3 at-risk deals.
Priya: question on GTM focus: how aggressive on partner-sourced targets this quarter? are we tracking partner-influenced vs partner-sourced?
Noah: goal: 20% of new ARR from partners this quarter. We track two flavors: "sourced" (lead came via partner) and "influenced" (partner touched later). Both count toward partner goal but are tagged separately in CRM.
Ava: what about partner enablement? sales comps?
Noah: short answer: for pilots we have a bonus pool for AE/SEs for partner-sourced closes and a 10% referral credit to partner. We need a clear playbook for reps.
Marco: can we standardize the playbook into a one-pager: partner intro -> joint discovery -> pilot scoping -> exec signoff? reps need the checklist.
Lena: also add the technical checklist: infra reqs, network diagram, expected latencies, auth/KMS. That reduces surprises in procurement.
Priya: are we committing co-sell or just referral for the SI pilot?
Noah: pilot is co-sell + technical reseller for two target accounts. If pilot converts, we open a formal reseller agreement for EMEA.
Carlos: operational question: how do we mark a deal as "partner-led" in CRM? conversation tag or lead source?
Noah: use lead_source=Partner and add partner_name tag. SalesOps will pick these up for reporting.
Ava: any guidance for discounting on channel? we had some confusion last month.
Noah: guideline: channel pilot discount cap = 25% for ARR <= $250k. Anything above needs approval from Sales Lead + Finance.
Marco: curious about console visibility for partners. will partners see integration docs/how-to?
Lena: roadmap item: partner portal + integration docs surfaced in Console H2. Not GA yet but prioritized.
Priya: metrics ask: what KPI should AEs cite to show partner ROI? partner-sourced win rate? time-to-close?
Noah: recommend: partner-sourced win rate, average time-to-close delta (vs direct), and influenced-opp contribution to ARR. SalesOps will produce a starter dashboard.
Carlos: I'll add a report to the ops dashboard with those metrics. ETA EOW.
Marco: small ask  reps want to invite partner SE to customer calls, do we have an NDA/confidentiality protocol?
Lena: partners sign our partner NDA for pilot access. For production we use a standard SSO/integration access control flow.
Ava: any public-facing messaging about partners this quarter? marketing wants aligned language.
Noah: messaging allowed: "partner pilot with leading SI" and "enterprise private deployments available". avoid naming partner until pilot is mutually announced.
Priya: follow-up: onboarding SDRs to partners  is there a 1hr enablement session planned?
Noah: yes, Partner Enablement 101 scheduled next Tue 10am. Recording will go to #sales-playbooks.
Carlos: posted the procurement starter pack: https://intranet.redwood/dedicated-procurement-pack (link)
Marco: thanks. I'll pull the playbook into our region playbook and add partner contact points.
Lena: adding a tech appendix for KMS/HSM integration snippets and network reqs.
Noah: action items: 1) Carlos share procurement pack (done) 2) SalesOps create partner KPI dashboard (Carlos) 3) Assign owners for 3 at-risk Dedicated deals (Noah) 4) Partner Enablement session next Tue (Ava). I'll follow up in #sales.
OpsBot: Saved all-hands QA thread and actions to minutes: https://intranet.redwood/all-hands/1764104321-minutes
Ava: thanks everyone. quick thumbs if you can join the enablement session :thumbsup:
Priya: joining :thumbsup:
Marco: in calendar :calendar: 
Noah: closing thread, will move tasks into the partnerships board.
